STATEMENT OF PEDRO ANTONIO CASAS

PARTY PREFERENCE: REPUBLICAN

UNITED STATES REPRESENTATIVE, 38th DISTRICT

Dr. Pedro 'Antonio' Casas, Ph.D., Colonel, U.S. Army (retired) (29 years of service).

Licensed Clinical/Forensic/Aero-Medical Psychologist.
Raised in Baldwin Park (picked oranges) – Parents from Zacatecas, Mexico.
Deployment to Afghanistan as a Commander.
Two deployments to Iraq as Chief of Mental Health.
Testified in criminal trials as expert for prosecution of rapists and pedophiles.
Los Angeles Courts; represented undocumented immigrants, victims of domestic violence, military veterans; free of charge.
Top Secret Assignments: Commander, Pentagon, F.B.I., N.S.A., Site R.

As your Congressman:

Immigration Bill will PROTECT Immigrants.
My plan will remove child pornographers, child rapists, murders, from our Country.
Medical Bill for Immigrants.
No Men in Women's/Girl's Sports.
No Men in Girls Bathrooms.
No child mutilation surgery.
'Parent Rights' in children's education.
Catholic/Christian values.
JROTC at every high school – ROTC expanded to junior colleges.
AFFORDABILITY thru 1) lower state and federal income taxes, 2) lower gas by $2 per gallon, 3) lower property taxes, 4) lower car and property insurance, 5) fewer regulations/taxes to help small businesses, 6) low-income homes/mortgages.
Every single problem above has been present for DECADES: I HAVE SOLUTIONS TO MAKE YOUR LIFE BETTER.

Dr. Casas will lose over $75,000 every single year from his private practice to serve the people. My agenda will FIX the worst schools in the Country, lower homelessness, lower drug abuse, lower out of control crime, and investigate FRAUD, which have been present for DECADES.

I WILL FIGHT TO MAKE YOUR LIFE BETTER; NOT GET RICH!

JROTC (Cuerpo de Entrenamiento de Oficiales de Reserva Junior) presente en todas las preparatorias – el ROTC (Cuerpo de Entrenamiento de Oficiales de Reserva) extendido a los colegios de dos años.

STATEMENT OF HILDA SOLIS

PARTY PREFERENCE: DEMOCRATIC

UNITED STATES REPRESENTATIVE, 38th DISTRICT

The working people of Southern California deserve a strong advocate in Congress. County Supervisor Hilda Solis is a proven fighter, and we can count on her to fight to create local jobs and economic growth, make neighborhoods safer, and tackle inflation and the high cost of health care, groceries, gasoline, insurance, housing and rent.

That's why Hilda Solis is the candidate in the 38th District endorsed by nurses, firefighters, deputies, small business owners, Planned Parenthood Action Fund, and unions representing tens of thousands of working families.

Hilda Solis has demonstrated that she stands up for the people – not the powerful – as an educator, lawmaker, U.S. Representative, President Barack Obama's Secretary of Labor, and county supervisor. She works across party lines to get things done, and is endorsed by Independents and the Democratic Party.

Raised in the San Gabriel Valley as the daughter of immigrants, Hilda Solis fights for affordable healthcare for all. She's fighting back against the Trump Administration as they slash Medi-Cal for millions of Southern California residents. Hilda Solis fights for solutions to save the health and emergency care systems – and that's why she's supported by United Healthcare Workers.

Hilda Solis works to make our neighborhoods safer. That's why she's supported by Sheriff Robert Luna and Los Angeles County Firefighters Local #1014.

Hilda Solis works to improve our local economy so that people can earn more at work and get a fair chance to buy or rent an affordable home. She secured grants for small businesses to create local jobs. And Hilda Solis fights to lower the cost of living for all.

We need Hilda Solis in Congress, fighting for us.
